🚨 CVE-2026-91754 - VMware
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: VMware
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability in Hitachi Dynamic Link Manager for VMware. This issue affects Hitachi Dynamic Link Manager for VMware: from 8.7.3-00 before 9.0.4-01.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-91754
 
🚨 CVE-2026-104259 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.4
Resumo:
ModSecurity is an open source, cross platform web application firewall (WAF) engine for Apache, IIS and Nginx. Prior to 2.9.15 and 3.0.17, msre_fn_removeComments_execute in apache2/re_tfns.c and inplace() in src/actions/transformations/remove_comments.cc implement t:removeComments by copying the character immediately after a comment terminator without re-evaluating it. Adjacent comments can therefore leave a later co...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-104259
 
🚨 CVE-2026-123368 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.22.0 until 0.31.0, compose-lint follows a sibling .env symbolic link outside the project without applying its normal containment check. From 0.28.0, the same gap also affects an include project_directory link outside the project. A pull request can reference a variable from the linked file, causing s...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-123368

🚨 Google Issues Chrome Security Update for Eighth Actively Exploited Zero-Day of 2026
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Google on Monday released updates to patch nine security vulnerabilities, including one that has come under active exploitation in the wild. The high-severity vulnerability, assigned the CVE identifier CVE-2026-125350 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a use-after-free bug in the XML component. Use-after-free bugs typically occur when a program attempts to access a memory location after
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/google-issues-chrome-security-update.html
 
🚨 CVE-2026-112318 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a policy request with an empty policy name that reaches authorization checks or logging code.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-112318

🚨 CVE-2026-115204 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.8
Resumo:
The AZEXO Store Locator WordPress plugin through 1.4 does not perform capability or nonce checks on its AJAX actions and does not sanitise a request header used to build a file path, allowing any authenticated user such as a subscriber to write a file with an arbitrary name, location, and content, leading to remote code execution.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-115204

When a workflow processes a pull request, legacy ##[ commands or a line-leading double-colon command...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-123369
 
🚨 CVE-2026-115336 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
Incorrect quota accounting in Progress Software WS_FTP Server releases prior to 2025.0.5 on Windows could allow an authenticated user with upload and delete permissions to exceed storage quotas, potentially causing denial of service.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-115336
